response.summary: Checkout-service experienced a significant increase in resident memory usage, leading to OutOfMemoryError exceptions and GC overhead warnings during the investigation window.

likely_causes.title: Memory leak in application code causing gradual heap exhaustion
likely_causes.rationale: The resident memory rose 1.8x and repeated OutOfMemoryError and GC overhead warnings indicate heap exhaustion, typical of a memory leak.

likely_causes.rationale: Heap usage reached 92% and OOM errors occurred, suggesting the configured heap size may be too low for the workload.

next_steps: Collect and analyze heap dumps from the affected instances to identify retained objects
Review recent code changes or deployments that could introduce memory leaks
Increase JVM heap size and monitor memory usage to confirm mitigation
